messages.content:
<ticket id="t002">
When I paste a table from Google Sheets into a note, the columns collapse into one long line of text. Using Lumen web on Chrome 131. It worked fine last week.
</ticket>

input.task: Classify ticket t002 by category and priority. Customer report: when pasting a table from Google Sheets into a note in Lumen web (Chrome 131), the columns collapse into one long line of text. It worked fine last week.
Check for known issues or recent changes affecting pasting tables from Google Sheets into notes in Lumen web, especially on Chrome 131. Report any relevant facts only.

content.content: The ticket (t002, bug, normal priority) reports that pasting a Google Sheets table into a note on Lumen web with Chrome 131 collapses the columns into one long line, and that it worked the previous week. Searches for Google Sheets/table paste issues and for Chrome 131 found no other tickets describing this problem or any recent change affecting it. The only related-sounding ticket, t058, describes a different symptom (blank notebooks and session expiry), so I found no known issue that explains this one.

input.task: Write a reply to ticket t002 acknowledging the report that pasting a Google Sheets table into a Lumen web note on Chrome 131 collapses columns into one line, which worked last week. Say it has been logged as a bug and the team is looking into it. Do not promise a fix, date, or refund. Ask for any extra detail that would help, such as a screenshot or whether it happens in other browsers.

content.content: Thanks for reporting this, and sorry the table paste broke after working fine last week. We've logged it as a bug and the team is looking into it. If you can, please send a screenshot of the note after pasting, and let us know whether the same thing happens in another browser or with a different Google Sheets range, as that will help us narrow it down.

input.task: Check the current draft reply for ticket t002 against the rubric: no promised fixes, dates, or refunds; acknowledges the issue; asks for useful detail; polite and accurate to the ticket. Pass or fail with reasons.
